## RE:volution Mod v2.11.0

### Added

- Added permanent, server-authoritative Unique Rune Collections as a separate system from ordinary Runes.
- Added three fixed 26-Rune collections: Crystal, Daily and Offerings.
- Added Crystal acquisition with server-side rolls, factual ownership checks and Pearl compensation for duplicates.
- Added Daily acquisition with one factual claim per day and exclusion of current-cycle duplicates.
- Added Offerings acquisition using the existing persistent Offerings wallet, with duplicate rolls and no duplicate compensation.
- Added the permanent `pearl` resource and Crystal-only Unique Rune enhancement with per-Rune Balance Core cost curves and an unlimited data-driven tail.
- Added Collection Awakening after factual `26/26`, promoting one selected Rune into the next gameplay rarity while preserving permanent enhancement state.
- Added paid Collection rollback using an exact pre-Awakening snapshot and an explicit two-step client warning/confirmation flow.
- Added Unique Rune rarity progression `COMMON -> IMPROVED -> ADVANCED -> MYTHIC`; `ANCIENT` remains reserved and disabled for gameplay.
- Added a dedicated Unique Rune modifier layer in the resource and damage pipelines before later permanent systems such as GOD and AURA.
- Added persistent Mongo state for collection rarity, factual ownership, enhancement, Daily claim state and rollback snapshots.
- Added dedicated network discriminators `25/26` for Unique Rune actions and server-authored snapshots without changing existing packet IDs.
- Added monotonic replay protection for mutating Unique Rune actions and reconnect-safe client nonce seeding.
- Added server-authored Unique Rune Share payloads containing factual collection, rarity, enhancement and calculated effects.
- Added a functional-first Unique Rune UI with three collection views, `X/26` progression, balances, acquisition, enhancement, Awakening, Share and rollback confirmation.
- Added `balance/v2.11.0-unique-runes.json` with data-driven definitions, unlocks, costs, compensation, rarity scaling, enhancement curves and effects.

### Fixed

- Prevented replayed or lower-nonce Unique Rune mutation requests from applying twice.
- Prevented Daily rewards from producing a duplicate Rune in the active rarity cycle.
- Prevented non-Crystal Unique Runes from using the Pearl enhancement flow.
- Prevented rollback from applying without explicit confirmation or from replaying the same saved rollback snapshot.
- Preserved exact pre-Awakening ownership when rolling a collection back.
- Kept ordinary Rune, Pet, Aura, Achievement and God Worship state isolated from Unique Rune collection persistence.
- Locked the damage modifier registration order so Unique Rune remains before GOD and AURA late layers.
- Extended architecture and resource contracts for the new adapters, packet IDs and Balance overlay.

### Other

- The current Unique Rune numerical balance is marked **ZBT Draft**. The v2.11.0 stable contract covers architecture, persistence, server authority, modifier ordering and data-driven configuration rather than final production numbers.
- Crystal and Daily unlock milestones remain Balance Core driven; Offerings Collection requires factual God Worship access.
- The UI remains a functional-first skeleton; final visual polish is outside the scope of this release.
- Existing Runes, Pets, Quests, God Worship, Auras, Achievements, Mastery, resource economy, networking, architecture/security guards and packaged JAR contracts remain covered by the full regression suite.

Download `RE-volution-2.11.0.jar` from the assets attached to this GitHub Release.
